Name: Summer Treats
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[u]Features : 

[/u]- A frozen yogurt machine which makes frozen yogurt from fruit and milk

- A Blender to make smoothie's from fruit

- A Freezer which creates popsicle's from fruit

[u]Installation : 
[/u]- Unzip The file
- Copy / Paste into Mods folder
- All set!

[u]Instructions : 

[/u]- While the machines explain how to make the items, they don't explain how to obtain themselves or what items are available.
- Frozen yogurt Dispenser : Purchase from Sandy in the calico desert during sunny weather (Summer Only)
- Blender : Purchase from Robin during sunny weather (Spring and Summer)
- Freezer : Purchase from Robin during sunny weather (Summer Only)
- Available items : All standard fruits, Except: Hot Pepper, Rhubarb and Spice Berry

[u]That's All : 
[/u]Hope you enjoy it!

[i][u]Update 1.1.0 : 
[/u][/i]The summer heat waves blasted in items from PPJA's More Tree's.
The mod now supports select fruits from More Tree's. A full guide for objects is being worked on.
